From bcv-commons/bibles `tools/verse-text/js/`, commit 81073fe (verse-text 2.0.0), the same commit
bible-song-builder vendors the rest of verse-text from. Unchanged. Licence: LICENSE (CC0).

- `helloao_to_usj.mjs`: helloAO chapter JSON to USJ (the helloAO route).
- `extract_sofria.js`, `rule.js`: verse text from a Sofria chapter (the DBT `sofria` route).
- `extract_plain.js`: verse text from DBT's text_plain verses (the `plain` route).
